world.title: US resumes Iran naval blockade, launches fourth straight day of strikes over Strait of Hormuz
world.summary: The United States has resumed its naval blockade of Iranian ports and coastal areas, initiating a fourth consecutive day of strikes against Iranian military targets. Central Command (Centcom) confirmed the blockade's restart following the latest military actions. This escalation reflects ongoing tensions in the region, particularly concerning the strategic Strait of Hormuz, a critical maritime passage for global oil shipments.

world.title: US eases Russia sanctions bill, cuts tariff threat on India and China from 500% to 100%
world.summary: US senators introduced a revised Russia sanctions bill aimed at pressuring Moscow and its key energy buyers, notably India and China. The updated legislation reduces the proposed tariff threat on these countries from 500% to 100%. This change reflects a strategic adjustment in the US approach to sanctions while maintaining focus on Russia's energy market influence.

world.title: Trump backs bill that could hit India with 500% tariffs over Russian oil trade
world.summary: Donald Trump has endorsed a US sanctions bill that may impose tariffs of up to 500% on countries purchasing Russian oil, affecting India and China. During a discussion, he indicated that the matter requires further consideration. This development could strain India's trade relations with the United States, as it navigates its energy imports amid geopolitical tensions.

business.title: Based On Tekton Launching Soon
business.summary: Nissan is set to launch a new 7-seater vehicle based on the Tekton in the Indian market. The company has experienced significant fluctuations in its presence, with past successes including the Micra, Sunny, and Terrano, contrasted by challenges faced during the Datsun experiment. This upcoming model aims to revitalize Nissan's standing in India.

business.title: Stocks to Watch Today: Ather Energy, Belrise Industries, PDS, Kirloskar Brothers, Kusumgar, IOL Chemicals, Delhivery, L&T Technology in focus on 15 July
business.summary: On July 15, 2026, several stocks will be in focus, including L&T Technology Services, Tata Elxsi, Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers, Ather Energy, Belrise Industries, PDS, Kirloskar Brothers, Easy Trip Planners, and IOL Chemicals and Pharmaceuticals. Investors are advised to monitor these companies for significant developments, including investments, deals, earnings reports, and acquisitions.

business.title: Maharashtra FDA suspends licences of 3 Mumbai restaurants over hygiene lapses
business.summary: The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has suspended the licences of three Mumbai restaurants due to hygiene violations. This action follows the recent closure of the K Rustom ice cream parlour, where inspections revealed the presence of rats, flies, and expired flavouring agents. The FDA continues to enforce food safety regulations to ensure public health standards are met.

technology.title: Patchpocalypse Now: Microsoft tops last month's record with 622 Patch Tuesday CVEs
technology.summary: Microsoft has surpassed its previous record by addressing 622 Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) in its latest Patch Tuesday update. This significant increase follows last month's record of 206 CVEs. The latest patches cover various Microsoft products, reflecting the company's ongoing efforts to enhance security and address vulnerabilities in its software ecosystem.

technology.title: Spotify brings chatbot-powered music discovery
technology.summary: Spotify has introduced a new feature called Talk to Spotify, allowing Premium subscribers to engage with the service through conversational interactions. This beta feature utilizes artificial intelligence to enhance music discovery, enabling users to ask questions and receive personalized recommendations. The initiative aims to improve user experience by making music exploration more intuitive and accessible through natural dialogue.

technology.title: PlayStation's Social Feeds Are Still on Fire
technology.summary: Sony's decision to discontinue physical disc production for PlayStation has sparked significant backlash on social media, continuing two weeks after the announcement. Analysts suggest that the company's focus on digital profits makes a reversal of this decision unlikely. Developers utilizing PlayStation’s promotional channels are facing challenges as negative comments about Blu-ray discs dominate discussions, overshadowing their work.

sports.title: France vs Spain, FIFA World Cup semifinal LIVE: Porro scores as Spain goes 2-0 up
sports.summary: Spain is leading France 2-0 in the FIFA World Cup semifinal at AT&T Stadium in Arlington on July 14, 2026. Porro scored one of the goals for Spain. France has made changes to their lineup, recalling Bradley Barcola for the attack and Aurelien Tchouameni in midfield. The match is being closely followed by fans and analysts.

sports.title: Tottenham demand €50m for Romero, too expensive for Inter
sports.summary: Tottenham Hotspur are asking for €50 million to sell defender Cristian Romero, according to Sportitalia. This high price makes it unlikely that Inter Milan will secure his transfer ahead of Barcelona. The situation has been discussed by Fabrizio Romano on his YouTube channel, highlighting the financial challenges Inter faces in pursuing the player amid competition from Barcelona.

sports.title: Shubman Gill's 80, Axar-Washington stand give India 1-0 lead over England in ODI series
sports.summary: Shubman Gill scored 80 runs as India beat England by six wickets in the first ODI at Edgbaston on Tuesday, taking a 1-0 lead in the three-match series. Gill's performance highlighted his strong record at the venue. The match showcased a solid partnership between Axar Patel and Washington Sundar, contributing to India's successful chase of the target.

health.title: IMA issues diectives on Chandipura virus in Gujarat
health.summary: The Gujarat State Branch of the Indian Medical Association (GSB-IMA) has issued an advisory regarding the Chandipura virus, urging pediatricians to assess child histories and symptoms such as high fever and convulsions, following three reported deaths. The medical body emphasized the importance of strict preventive measures to control the spread of this dangerous sandfly-borne virus in the region.

health.title: 3 children dead, 4 on life support as Chandipura virus outbreak hits Gujarat
health.summary: Gujarat has reported 32 suspected cases of the Chandipura virus since July 1, with seven confirmed infections among children. Three children have died, and four others are on life support due to the outbreak. The health department is on high alert, increasing surveillance, treatment, and sandfly-control measures to manage the situation effectively and prevent further spread.

health.title: FDA's Traceback Endeavor: Tackling Cyclosporiasis Outbreak
health.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is investigating multiple produce items to determine the source of a cyclosporiasis outbreak, an intestinal infection linked to contaminated raw fruits and vegetables. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention highlights the risks associated with such contaminated produce. The FDA's traceback efforts aim to enhance food safety and public health.

science.title: Scientists use sound waves to create protective crystal coatings on crops
science.summary: Researchers at RMIT University have developed a novel method using high-frequency sound waves to spray protective crystal coatings onto living plant leaves. This innovative technique creates a fine mist that forms crystal layers, enhancing crop protection without harming the plants. The approach aims to improve agricultural practices by providing a safe and effective way to shield crops from environmental threats.

science.title: Earliest galaxies were well organised less than a billion years after Big Bang, reveals IUCAA study
science.summary: A study by IUCAA utilizing the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) has discovered that spheroidal galaxies formed 400–900 million years after the Big Bang exhibit organized structures, adhering to the Kormendy relation. This finding indicates that early galaxies were more structured than previously thought, suggesting advanced formation processes in the universe's infancy.

science.title: A new fabrication technique for the ultra-clean manufacturing of 2D heterostructures
science.summary: Researchers have introduced a novel fabrication technique aimed at the ultra-clean production of 2D heterostructures. This method is anticipated to facilitate the development of next-generation devices, potentially accelerating advancements in quantum computing. The innovation could significantly impact the field, providing a cleaner and more efficient approach to manufacturing essential components for future technological applications.

entertainment.title: Aamir Khan faces fatwa after marrying Gauri Spratt; cleric objects to interfaith marriage: 'Gair Muslim se shaadi karna haraam hai'
entertainment.summary: Aamir Khan has sparked controversy following his marriage to Gauri Spratt, as a Muslim cleric has issued a fatwa against the interfaith union. The cleric argues that marrying a non-Muslim is impermissible according to his interpretation of Islamic law. This objection has drawn attention to the challenges faced by interfaith couples within certain religious communities.

entertainment.title: Ayodhya priest's remark sparks uproar
entertainment.summary: A religious leader has offered a Rs 5 crore reward for the killing of actor Aamir Khan, following backlash over his marriage to Gauri Spratt. The situation escalated with protests, effigy burnings, and accusations of "love jihad" from members of the Bajrang Dal. Khan has faced ongoing criticism and threats since the announcement of their union.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: Daily astrological predictions for July 15, 2026
entertainment.summary: Horoscope predictions for July 15, 2026, are available, detailing astrological influences on all 12 zodiac signs. The analysis includes the movements of planets and their alignment, providing insights into how these celestial events may affect individuals. Readers can explore personalized forecasts based on their zodiac signs to understand potential impacts on their daily lives.
